headline: All three refunds ($9.50, $9.00, $1.50) follow from the fee schedules and the documented 'net correction' rule, but some of the errors that count are dated after the benchmark's fixed 'today'.

issues.summary: Three of the discrepancies in the gold credits fall after the fixed clock (11/14/2025 03:40): Green's duplicate $3.00 fee on 11/15 (+$3.00), Light Green's 11/15 $150 foreign withdrawal charged $5.00 instead of $3.50 (+$1.50), and Light Green's uncharged 11/17 withdrawal (-$1.50).
evidence: db.json chk_kj93a7b2e1_2 11/15/2025 two atm_fee -3.0 'NON-RHO ATM FEE' rows for one -250.0 PNC withdrawal
db.json chk_kj93a7b2e1_3 11/15/2025 atm_fee -5.0 'FOREIGN ATM FEE - TIER 3 (ABOVE $300)' on -150.0 KB KOOKMIN
issues.why_it_matters: An agent that only reviews transactions on or before today gets Green $6.00 and fails. The natural reading, the full November history as returned with status 'posted', reaches the gold.
issues.suggested_fix: Re-date the seeded rows to fall on or before 11/14/2025 or advance the clock.

solution_check: Blue (1% max $3.00 out-of-network; foreign 3% min $5.00): 11/05 $300 charged $4.50 instead of $3.00 (+$1.50), 11/09 $500 Seoul charged $20.00 instead of $15.00 (+$5.00), and 11/13 RHO-BANK ATM charged $3.00, which should be $0 because Blue says 'Use in-network ATMs to avoid the 1% out-of-network fee' (+$3.00). Net $9.50. Green ($3.00 out-of-network; foreign 3% min $5.00): 11/07 RHO-BANK $3.00 (+$3.00), 11/09 $400 charged $15.00 instead of $12.00 (+$3.00), and the 11/15 duplicate fee (+$3.00). Net $9.00. Light Green (4 free then $1.50; foreign tiers): the 2nd withdrawal on 11/03 is charged (+$1.50), the 11/15 $150 is charged at tier 3 (+$1.50), and the 7th domestic withdrawal on 11/17 is uncharged (-$1.50). Net $1.50. All values are exact (no rounding), each account gets one fee_refund credit per doc_017, and this matches the gold.
prior_note: The prior review gave Major for the in-network-fee inference and netting. Both are documented (in-network ATMs avoid the out-of-network fee, and doc_017 requires a net correction), so this review downgrades to Minor for the after-clock dating.
notes: Cosmetic inconsistencies: customer DOB 09/14/1994 (age 31) holds a Light Green Account restricted to ages 13-24 (light_green_account_002), and Light Green's $150 daily ATM limit is exceeded by the 11/19 $350 withdrawal. Neither affects the credits. One possible reading also charges $1.50 out-of-network fees on foreign Light Green withdrawals once the 4 free withdrawals are used, which would add missing fees. No document supports stacking, and the seed data and tasks 072/074 treat foreign withdrawals as carrying only the foreign fee. v1.0.1 scrubbed the 'AFTER FREE ALLOWANCE' annotations on this account. Grading-model facts confirmed against the snapshot: reads are logged only when in the gold-derived allowlist (call_discoverable_agent_tool + _derive_read_log_allowlist); writes are always logged; call_discoverable_agent_tool parses JSON with parse_int=float; get_now() = datetime(2025, 11, 14, 3, 40, 0). Verified scorer (working-repo evaluator_env.py _verified_db_match) confirmed: gold discoverable tool names must be a subset of the agent's, closure_reason stripped from every record, all other tables compared exactly.
